revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Margaret's New Pet
revealWordProblem.text:
Margaret is researching dog breeds to adopt. The average weight of a bulldog is 50 pounds, and the list gives the other breeds she is considering.
Pugs weigh 32 pounds less than bulldogs.
Irish Setters weigh 20 pounds more than bulldogs.
Irish Terriers weigh 43 pounds less than Irish Setters.
Shiba Inu weigh 5 pounds more than pugs.
Question: If Margaret's apartment building only allows dogs up to 30 pounds, which breed or breeds would you recommend she adopt?
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: A photograph of a bulldog with a card reading: Average Weight of Bulldog, 50 pounds.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Start from the bulldog's 50 pounds and write an equation for each breed. Pug: p = 50 − 32 = 18 pounds. Irish Setter: s = 50 + 20 = 70 pounds. Irish Terrier: t = 70 − 43 = 27 pounds. Shiba Inu: i = 18 + 5 = 23 pounds. Now compare each with the 30-pound limit: pug 18 ✓, Shiba Inu 23 ✓, Irish Terrier 27 ✓, bulldog 50 ✗, Irish Setter 70 ✗. I would recommend the pug, the Shiba Inu, or the Irish Terrier — all three are under the building's 30-pound limit.

conceptIntro.heading: How do I solve an addition or subtraction equation?
conceptIntro.intro: To solve means to find the value that makes the equation true. I use the inverse operation (the opposite) to get the variable alone, and I do the same thing to both sides.
conceptIntro.keyIdea: Solving Addition & Subtraction Equations. Formula: x + a = b → x = b − a | x − a = b → x = b + a. 1. Identify operation on variable. 2. Use inverse operation: subtract to undo addition; add to undo subtraction. 3. Property of Equality: do same operation to both sides.

iDo.title: Watch me
lines: Solve n + 23 = 58. The 23 is added to n.
The inverse of adding 23 is subtracting 23.
I subtract 23 from both sides: n + 23 − 23 = 58 − 23.
linesEs: Resuelve n + 23 = 58. El 23 se le suma a n.
La inversa de sumar 23 es restar 23.
Resto 23 en los dos lados: n + 23 − 23 = 58 − 23.

weDo.title: Let's try together
lines: Solve x − 4 = 9. Is x being added or subtracted?
It is subtracted, so the inverse is adding 4 to both sides.
linesEs: Resuelve x − 4 = 9. ¿A x se le está sumando o restando?
Se le está restando, así que la inversa es sumar 4 en los dos lados.

youDo.title: Now it's your turn
lines: Use the balance scale to solve n + 19 = 46 — a new equation, not the n + 23 = 58 we just watched.
Then solve the practice equations and check each answer.
linesEs: Usa la balanza para resolver n + 19 = 46 — una ecuación nueva, no la n + 23 = 58 que acabamos de ver.
Luego resuelve las ecuaciones de práctica y comprueba cada respuesta.

conceptIntro.headingEs: ¿Cómo resuelvo una ecuación de suma o de resta?
conceptIntro.introEs: Resolver significa hallar el valor que hace verdadera la ecuación. Uso la operación inversa (la contraria) para dejar sola la variable, y hago lo mismo en los dos lados.
conceptIntro.keyIdeaEs: Resolver ecuaciones de suma y resta. Fórmula: x + a = b → x = b − a | x − a = b → x = b + a. 1. Identifica la operación aplicada a la variable. 2. Usa la operación inversa: resta para deshacer una suma; suma para deshacer una resta. 3. Propiedad de igualdad: aplica la misma operación inversa a los dos lados de la ecuación

figure.alt: A balance scale. The left pan holds n + 23 and the right pan holds 58, showing the two sides are equal.

explore.instructions: Use the balance scale to solve n + 19 = 46. What must you do to both sides to isolate n?
hints: To isolate n, you need to remove the +19. What is the inverse of adding 19?
Subtract 19 from BOTH sides: n + 19 − 19 = 46 − 19 → n = 27.
explore.label: Solve the equation using the balance scale. Keep both sides equal!

discourse.prompt: Why do you have to subtract 19 from BOTH sides, not just one?
discourse.sentenceFrame: I subtract from both sides because an equation is like a ___ — to keep it balanced, any operation on one side must ___.
discourse.promptEs: ¿Por qué tienes que restar 19 de los dos lados y no solo de uno?
discourse.sentenceFrameEs: Resto de los dos lados porque una ecuación es como una ___ — para mantenerla equilibrada, cualquier operación de un lado debe ___.

explore.instructionsEs: Usa la balanza para resolver n + 19 = 46. ¿Qué le debes hacer a los dos lados para dejar sola a n?
explore.labelEs: Resuelve la ecuación usando la balanza. ¡Mantén los dos lados iguales!
hintsEs: Para dejar sola a n, necesitas quitar el +19. ¿Cuál es la inversa de sumar 19?
Resta 19 de los dos lados: n + 19 − 19 = 46 − 19 → n = 27.

diagram.intro: Now write the solving steps on paper-style lines — I'll check each one keeps the same solution.

optional.explanation: Subtract 7 from both sides: x = 15 − 7 = 8. Check: 8 + 7 = 15 ✓
choiceFeedback: That is the number being added in the equation, not the unknown value. Subtract it from both sides to uncover x.
Not quite. Subtract 7 from both sides: x = 15 − 7 = ___.
The two numbers got multiplied. Addition is undone by subtraction, so take 7 away from both sides instead.
optional.explanationEs: Resta 7 en ambos lados: x = 15 − 7 = 8. Comprueba: 8 + 7 = 15 ✓
hints: The equation shows something being added to x, and the equal sign means both sides have the same value.
Use the inverse operation: whatever is added to x should be subtracted from both sides.
Subtract 7 from both sides. The left side becomes just x, and the right side becomes 15 − 7 — finish that subtraction.
hintsEs: La ecuación muestra que algo se le suma a x, y el signo igual significa que ambos lados tienen el mismo valor.
Usa la operación inversa: lo que se le suma a x debe restarse en ambos lados.
Resta 7 en ambos lados. El lado izquierdo queda solo como x y el derecho queda como 15 − 7 — termina esa resta.

optional.explanation: Add 4 to both sides: n = 9 + 4 = 13. Check: 13 − 4 = 9 ✓
choiceFeedback: The subtraction ran in the wrong direction. Since 4 was taken away from n, n has to be larger than 9 — add 4 to both sides.
Not quite. Add 4 to both sides: n = 9 + 4 = ___.
The numbers were multiplied instead of combined with the inverse operation. Subtraction is undone by addition, so add 4 to both sides.
optional.explanationEs: Suma 4 en ambos lados: n = 9 + 4 = 13. Comprueba: 13 − 4 = 9 ✓
hints: This equation takes an amount away from n, and you need to find what n was before that happened.
Undo a subtraction with addition, applying it to both sides of the equation.
Add 4 to both sides. The left side becomes just n, and the right side becomes 9 + 4 — finish that addition.
hintsEs: Esta ecuación le quita una cantidad a n, y tienes que hallar cuánto valía n antes de eso.
Deshaz una resta con una suma, aplicándola a ambos lados de la ecuación.
Suma 4 en ambos lados. El lado izquierdo queda solo como n y el derecho queda como 9 + 4 — termina esa suma.

optional.stem: Unlock Card 3: A vault held some clue tokens. After the detective added 16 tokens, there were 50. The equation is t + 16 = 50. How many tokens were there before?
optional.explanation: Subtract 16 from both sides: t = 50 − 16 = 34. Check: 34 + 16 = 50 ✓
choiceFeedback: That is the number of tokens the detective added, not how many were there before. Subtract 16 from both sides to find the starting amount.
Not quite. Subtract 16 from both sides: t = 50 − 16 = ___.
The two numbers got multiplied. Since 16 was added to t, subtract 16 from both sides instead.
optional.stemEs: Tarjeta de desbloqueo 3: Una bóveda tenía algunas fichas de pistas. Después de que el detective agregó 16 fichas, había 50. La ecuación es t + 16 = 50. ¿Cuántas fichas había antes?
optional.explanationEs: Resta 16 en ambos lados: t = 50 − 16 = 34. Comprueba: 34 + 16 = 50 ✓
hints: Tokens were added to a starting amount to reach 50, so the starting amount has to be smaller than 50.
The equation t + 16 = 50 is undone by subtracting 16 from both sides.
Subtract 16 from both sides. The left side leaves just t, and the right side becomes 50 − 16 — finish that subtraction.
hintsEs: Se agregaron fichas a una cantidad inicial hasta llegar a 50, así que la cantidad inicial tiene que ser menor que 50.
La ecuación t + 16 = 50 se deshace restando 16 en ambos lados.
Resta 16 en ambos lados. El lado izquierdo deja solo a t y el derecho queda como 50 − 16 — termina esa resta.

optional.label: Unlock Card 4: Match each equation to its solution to crack the vault code.
optional.hint: Read each item carefully, then match based on what the problem is asking.
optional.explanation: Undo each operation to unlock its value: a + 6 = 13 needs subtraction, so a = 7; b − 5 = 8 needs addition, so b = 13; c + 11 = 20 needs subtraction, so c = 9; and d − 9 = 6 needs addition, so d = 15. Watch that the addition equations produce solutions smaller than the total while the subtraction equations produce larger ones.
optional.explanationEs: Deshaz cada operación para descubrir su valor: a + 6 = 13 necesita resta, así que a = 7; b − 5 = 8 necesita suma, así que b = 13; c + 11 = 20 necesita resta, así que c = 9; y d − 9 = 6 necesita suma, así que d = 15. Fíjate en que las ecuaciones con suma dan soluciones menores que el total, mientras que las de resta dan soluciones mayores.
optional.labelEs: Tarjeta 4: Une cada ecuación con su solución para descifrar el código de la bóveda.

optional.title: Level 2 Extension — Crack the Detective's Mistake
optional.correctWork: To undo + 8 you SUBTRACT 8 from both sides, not add: x + 8 − 8 = 21 − 8, so x = 13. Check: 13 + 8 = 21 ✓
hints: Step 3 adds 8 to both sides. Does adding 8 again remove the + 8?
The inverse of adding 8 is subtracting 8. Subtract 8 from both sides to isolate x.
optional.titleEs: Extensión de Nivel 2 — Descifra el error del detective
optional.explanation: The "Apply to both sides" step adds 8 again, which leaves x + 16 on the left instead of x alone. To undo + 8 you subtract 8 from both sides: x + 8 − 8 = 21 − 8, so x = 13. Checking, 13 + 8 = 21, while x = 29 would give 37.
optional.explanationEs: El paso "Apply to both sides" vuelve a sumar 8, lo que deja x + 16 a la izquierda en lugar de x sola. Para deshacer + 8 restas 8 en ambos lados: x + 8 − 8 = 21 − 8, así que x = 13. Al comprobar, 13 + 8 = 21, mientras que x = 29 daría 37.
optional.correctWorkEs: Para deshacer + 8 debes RESTAR 8 de ambos lados, no sumar: x + 8 − 8 = 21 − 8, así que x = 13. Comprueba: 13 + 8 = 21 ✓
hintsEs: El Paso 3 suma 8 a ambos lados. ¿Sumar 8 otra vez quita el + 8?
La operación inversa de sumar 8 es restar 8. Resta 8 de ambos lados para despejar x.

approaching.explanation: Subtract 9 from both sides: x = 15 − 9 = 6. Check: 6 + 9 = 15 ✓
choiceFeedback: That number is already showing in the equation as the amount being added, not the unknown. Undo the addition by subtracting it from both sides.
That is the total after 9 was added, not the starting value. Work backward from the total by subtracting 9 from both sides.
Not quite. Subtract 9 from both sides: x = 15 − 9 = ___.
hints: x has 9 added to it. To get x alone, you need to UNDO that addition.
Use the inverse operation: subtraction undoes addition. Whatever you do, do it to BOTH sides to keep the balance.
Subtract 9 from both sides: x = 15 − 9. Then check by adding 9 back to your result — do you land on 15?
approaching.explanationEs: Resta 9 en ambos lados: x = 15 − 9 = 6. Comprueba: 6 + 9 = 15 ✓
hintsEs: A x se le suman 9. Para dejar x sola, tienes que DESHACER esa suma.
Usa la operación inversa: la resta deshace la suma. Lo que hagas, hazlo en AMBOS lados para mantener el equilibrio.
Resta 9 de ambos lados: x = 15 − 9. Luego comprueba sumando 9 de nuevo a tu resultado: ¿llegas a 15?

approaching.explanation: Add 7 to both sides: y = 20 + 7 = 27. Check: 27 − 7 = 20 ✓
choiceFeedback: That is the amount being subtracted, not the value of y. Undo the subtraction by adding it to both sides.
Not quite. Add 7 to both sides: y = 20 + 7 = ___.
The two numbers got multiplied. Subtraction is undone by addition, so add 7 to both sides instead.
hints: Look at what's happening to y: 7 is being SUBTRACTED. Which operation undoes subtraction?
Add the same amount to both sides so the equation stays balanced and y ends up alone.
Add 7 to both sides: y = 20 + 7. Check your result: does it minus 7 give back 20?
approaching.explanationEs: Suma 7 en ambos lados: y = 20 + 7 = 27. Comprueba: 27 − 7 = 20 ✓
hintsEs: Mira lo que le pasa a y: se le RESTA 7. ¿Qué operación deshace una resta?
Suma la misma cantidad a ambos lados para que la ecuación siga equilibrada y y quede sola.
Suma 7 a ambos lados: y = 20 + 7. Comprueba tu resultado: ¿restarle 7 devuelve 20?

approaching.explanation: Subtract 15 from both sides: n = 42 − 15 = 27. Check: 27 + 15 = 42 ✓
choiceFeedback: That is the amount being added, not the starting value. Subtract 15 from both sides to peel it away from n.
That is the total after 15 was added. Work backward from the total by subtracting 15 from both sides.
Not quite. Subtract 15 from both sides: n = 42 − 15 = ___.
hints: n is being increased by 15. To find n alone, you must undo that addition.
Subtract 15 from both sides — the +15 and −15 cancel on the left, leaving just n.
Compute 42 − 15 carefully (42 − 10 = 32, then take away 5 more). Check by adding 15 back to your answer.
approaching.explanationEs: Resta 15 en ambos lados: n = 42 − 15 = 27. Comprueba: 27 + 15 = 42 ✓
hintsEs: A n se le aumentan 15. Para hallar n sola, debes deshacer esa suma.
Resta 15 de ambos lados: el +15 y el −15 se cancelan a la izquierda y queda solo n.
Calcula 42 − 15 con cuidado (42 − 10 = 32 y luego quita 5 más). Comprueba sumando 15 a tu respuesta.

approaching.explanation: Add 11 to both sides: m = 25 + 11 = 36. Check: 36 − 11 = 25 ✓
choiceFeedback: Not quite. Add 11 to both sides: m = 25 + 11 = ___.
That is the result after 11 was taken away, not the starting value. Add 11 to both sides to get back to m.
The two numbers got multiplied. Subtraction is undone by addition, so add 11 to both sides instead.
hints: m has 11 taken away from it. Think about which operation puts that 11 back.
Addition undoes subtraction: add 11 to both sides to leave m by itself.
Compute 25 + 11 for m. Then check: your answer minus 11 should equal 25.
approaching.explanationEs: Suma 11 en ambos lados: m = 25 + 11 = 36. Comprueba: 36 − 11 = 25 ✓
hintsEs: A m se le quitan 11. Piensa qué operación vuelve a poner ese 11.
La suma deshace la resta: suma 11 a ambos lados para dejar m sola.
Calcula 25 + 11 para m. Luego comprueba: tu respuesta menos 11 debe dar 25.

approaching.instructions: Use the number line to solve x + 8 = 20. Start at 20 and count back 8 to find x.
hints: Start at 20 on the number line. Since x + 8 = 20, subtract 8 to find x.
20 − 8 = 12, so x = 12. Place your marker at 12.
approaching.explanation: The equation x + 8 = 20 says that starting at x and moving 8 to the right lands on 20, so going backward from 20 undoes the move. Counting back 8 ticks from 20 gives 12, so the marker belongs on 12. Checking on the line, 12 + 8 does land on 20.
approaching.explanationEs: La ecuación x + 8 = 20 dice que al partir de x y avanzar 8 hacia la derecha se llega a 20, así que regresar desde 20 deshace ese movimiento. Al contar 8 marcas hacia atrás desde 20 se llega a 12, así que la marca va en 12. Al comprobar en la recta, 12 + 8 sí llega a 20.
hintsEs: Empieza en 20 en la recta numérica. Como x + 8 = 20, resta 8 para encontrar x.
20 − 8 = 12, así que x = 12. Coloca tu marcador en 12.

approaching.title: Spot the Common Mistake
approaching.correctWork: You must subtract 6 from BOTH sides, not just the left. x + 6 − 6 = 14 − 6, so x = 8. Check: 8 + 6 = 14 ✓
hints: Step 3 only subtracted 6 from the left side. What happened to the right side?
To keep the equation balanced, subtract 6 from both sides: 14 − 6 = 8, so x = 8.
approaching.explanation: The inverse operation chosen was right, but the "Subtract from one side only" step applies it to the left side alone. Whatever you do to one side of an equation must happen to the other, so subtract 6 from both: x + 6 − 6 = 14 − 6 gives x = 8. Checking, 8 + 6 = 14, while the student's x = 14 would make the left side 20.
approaching.explanationEs: La operación inversa elegida fue correcta, pero el paso "Subtract from one side only" la aplica solo al lado izquierdo. Lo que le haces a un lado de una ecuación se lo debes hacer al otro, así que resta 6 en ambos: x + 6 − 6 = 14 − 6 da x = 8. Al comprobar, 8 + 6 = 14, mientras que el x = 14 del estudiante haría que el lado izquierdo fuera 20.
approaching.correctWorkEs: Debes restar 6 de AMBOS lados, no solo del izquierdo. x + 6 − 6 = 14 − 6, así que x = 8. Comprueba: 8 + 6 = 14 ✓
hintsEs: El Paso 3 restó 6 solo del lado izquierdo. ¿Qué pasó con el lado derecho?
Para mantener la ecuación balanceada, resta 6 de ambos lados: 14 − 6 = 8, así que x = 8.

onLevel.label: Solve: m − 14 = 32
hints: The inverse of subtracting 14 is adding 14.
Add 14 to both sides: m = 32 + 14 = 46.
onLevel.explanation: In m − 14 = 32 the variable has 14 taken away from it, so add 14 to both sides to undo that: m = 32 + 14 = 46. Checking keeps the scale balanced, since 46 − 14 = 32.
onLevel.explanationEs: En m − 14 = 32 a la variable se le quitan 14, así que suma 14 en ambos lados para deshacerlo: m = 32 + 14 = 46. La comprobación mantiene la balanza equilibrada, ya que 46 − 14 = 32.
hintsEs: La operación inversa de restar 14 es sumar 14.
Suma 14 a ambos lados: m = 32 + 14 = 46.

onLevel.label: Complete the table: identify the inverse operation, solve, and check.
onLevel.hint: Work through each row step by step, checking your answer after each one.
hints: Every row asks the same three things: what is being done to the variable, how do you undo it, and does the check rebuild the original equation?
If the equation ADDS a number, the inverse is subtract; if it SUBTRACTS, the inverse is add. Always do it to both sides — decimals like 3.5 follow the same rule.
Row 1: x + 18 = 45 adds 18, so subtract 18 from both sides and compute 45 − 18. Verify by adding 18 back, then move to row 2.
onLevel.explanation: Each row names what is done to the variable, then undoes it on both sides. x + 18 = 45 adds 18, so subtract 18: x = 27, and 27 + 18 = 45. p − 22 = 19 subtracts 22, so add 22: p = 41, and 41 − 22 = 19. w + 3.5 = 10 adds 3.5, so subtract 3.5: w = 6.5, and 6.5 + 3.5 = 10 — decimals follow exactly the same rule.
onLevel.explanationEs: Cada fila nombra lo que se le hace a la variable y luego lo deshace en ambos lados. x + 18 = 45 suma 18, así que resta 18: x = 27, y 27 + 18 = 45. p − 22 = 19 resta 22, así que suma 22: p = 41, y 41 − 22 = 19. w + 3.5 = 10 suma 3.5, así que resta 3.5: w = 6.5, y 6.5 + 3.5 = 10; los decimales siguen exactamente la misma regla.
onLevel.labelEs: Completa la tabla: identifica la operación inversa, resuelve y comprueba.
hintsEs: Cada fila pide las mismas tres cosas: qué se le hace a la variable, cómo lo deshaces y si la comprobación reconstruye la ecuación original.
Si la ecuación SUMA un número, la inversa es restar; si RESTA, la inversa es sumar. Hazlo siempre en ambos lados: los decimales como 3.5 siguen la misma regla.
Fila 1: x + 18 = 45 suma 18, así que resta 18 de ambos lados y calcula 45 − 18. Verifica sumando 18 de nuevo y pasa a la fila 2.

onLevel.stem: A shirt costs $d. After a $15 discount, it costs $38. What is d?
choiceFeedback: That is what you get if you subtracted 15 from 38. Instead: d − 15 = 38 → d = 38 + 15 = $53.
That is the price after the discount, not the original price. The original price has to be larger, so add the discount back on.
The discount was not added back fully. Set up d − 15 = 38, then add 15 to both sides and combine carefully.
hints: The $15 discount was taken OFF the original price d, and $38 is what's left after the discount.
Write the story first: d − 15 = 38. Then undo the subtraction — the original price should be MORE than $38, not less.
Add the $15 discount back onto the $38 sale price: d = 38 + 15. Which choice matches that total?
onLevel.stemEs: Una camisa cuesta $d. Después de un descuento de $15, cuesta $38. ¿Cuánto vale d?
hintsEs: El descuento de $15 se le QUITÓ al precio original d, y $38 es lo que queda después del descuento.
Escribe primero la historia: d − 15 = 38. Luego deshaz la resta: el precio original debe ser MÁS de $38, no menos.
Vuelve a sumar los $15 del descuento al precio de oferta de $38: d = 38 + 15. ¿Qué opción coincide con ese total?

onLevel.instructions: Sort each equation into the correct inverse operation you would use to solve it.
hints: If the equation has addition (+), use subtraction to undo it.
If the equation has subtraction (−), use addition to undo it.
onLevel.label: Sort each equation by the inverse operation needed to solve it.
onLevel.explanation: The sign attached to the number beside the variable decides the move. x − 9 = 14, n − 20 = 35, and y − 6 = 8 all subtract from the variable, so you add to both sides to undo them. x + 12 = 30, n + 7 = 19, and y + 15 = 40 all add, so you subtract from both sides. You never need to solve them to sort — just read the operation.
onLevel.explanationEs: El signo que acompaña al número junto a la variable decide el movimiento. x − 9 = 14, n − 20 = 35 y y − 6 = 8 le restan a la variable, así que sumas en ambos lados para deshacerlo. x + 12 = 30, n + 7 = 19 y y + 15 = 40 suman, así que restas en ambos lados. No hace falta resolverlas para clasificarlas: basta con leer la operación.
onLevel.labelEs: Clasifica cada ecuación según la operación inversa que se necesita para resolverla.
hintsEs: Si la ecuación tiene suma (+), usa la resta para deshacerla.
Si la ecuación tiene resta (−), usa la suma para deshacerla.

onLevel.title: Spot the Common Mistake

workedExample.label: Choose inverse
workedExample.work: The inverse of − 13 is + 13, so add 13 to both sides.
workedExample.workEs: La inversa de − 13 es + 13, así que suma 13 a ambos lados.

onLevel.correctWork: The inverse operation was correct, but the addition was done wrong: 28 + 13 = 41, not 31. So y = 41. Check: 41 − 13 = 28 ✓
hints: The plan (add 13 to both sides) is right. Recheck the arithmetic in the last step.
Add carefully: 28 + 13 = 41, so y = 41, not 31.
onLevel.explanation: The plan was correct — adding 13 to both sides is the right inverse for y − 13 = 28 — but the "Simplify" step adds wrong. 28 + 13 = 41, not 31, so y = 41. Substituting back confirms it: 41 − 13 = 28, while 31 − 13 would give 18.
onLevel.explanationEs: El plan era correcto —sumar 13 en ambos lados es la inversa adecuada para y − 13 = 28—, pero el paso "Simplify" suma mal. 28 + 13 = 41, no 31, así que y = 41. Sustituir de regreso lo confirma: 41 − 13 = 28, mientras que 31 − 13 daría 18.
onLevel.correctWorkEs: La operación inversa era correcta, pero la suma se hizo mal: 28 + 13 = 41, no 31. Así que y = 41. Comprueba: 41 − 13 = 28 ✓
hintsEs: El plan (sumar 13 a ambos lados) está bien. Vuelve a revisar la aritmética del último paso.
Suma con cuidado: 28 + 13 = 41, así que y = 41, no 31.

extending.title: Find the Equation Error

workedExample.label: Identify inverse
workedExample.workEs: La inversa de la resta es la resta

extending.correctWork: Inverse of subtraction is ADDITION. Add 18 to both sides: x = 45 + 18 = 63.
hints: Step 2 says the inverse of subtraction is subtraction. Is that right?
To undo −18, you need +18, not another −18. Addition undoes subtraction.
extending.titleEs: Encuentra el error de la ecuación
extending.explanation: The "Identify inverse" step claims subtraction undoes subtraction, which pushes the equation further from the answer instead of isolating x. Addition undoes subtraction, so add 18 to both sides of x − 18 = 45: x = 45 + 18 = 63. Checking, 63 − 18 = 45, while the answer 27 would give 9.
extending.explanationEs: El paso "Identify inverse" afirma que la resta deshace la resta, lo que aleja la ecuación de la respuesta en lugar de despejar x. La suma deshace la resta, así que suma 18 en ambos lados de x − 18 = 45: x = 45 + 18 = 63. Al comprobar, 63 − 18 = 45, mientras que la respuesta 27 daría 9.
extending.correctWorkEs: La inversa de la resta es la SUMA. Suma 18 a ambos lados: x = 45 + 18 = 63.
hintsEs: El Paso 2 dice que la operación inversa de la resta es la resta. ¿Es correcto?
Para deshacer −18, necesitas +18, no otro −18. La suma deshace la resta.

extending.prompt: A detective solved x + 25 = 60 and got x = 35. Another detective solved y − 25 = 60 and got y = 35. Are both correct? Explain using inverse operations and check each answer.
extending.sentenceFrame: For x + 25 = 60, the inverse operation is ___, so x = ___. Check: ___. For y − 25 = 60, the inverse operation is ___, so y = ___. Check: ___. Therefore, ___.
extending.hint: Use a strategy or example from the lesson to help you explain your answer.
hints: The two equations use OPPOSITE operations (+25 and −25), so the same inverse step cannot work for both.
Solve each with its own inverse: subtract 25 for x + 25 = 60, but add 25 for y − 25 = 60. Then substitute each result back into its equation.
Start with x + 25 = 60: subtract 25 from both sides and compare with the detective's 35. Then add 25 for the y equation and see whether 35 survives that check.
extending.explanation: Only the first detective is right. For x + 25 = 60 the inverse is subtraction, so x = 60 − 25 = 35, and 35 + 25 = 60 checks out. For y − 25 = 60 the inverse is addition, so y = 60 + 25 = 85, not 35 — substituting 35 gives 35 − 25 = 10, not 60. Opposite operations need opposite inverses, even when the numbers look identical.
extending.explanationEs: Solo el primer detective tiene razón. Para x + 25 = 60 la inversa es la resta, así que x = 60 − 25 = 35, y 35 + 25 = 60 comprueba bien. Para y − 25 = 60 la inversa es la suma, así que y = 60 + 25 = 85, no 35: al sustituir 35 da 35 − 25 = 10, no 60. Operaciones opuestas necesitan inversas opuestas, aunque los números se vean idénticos.
extending.promptEs: Un detective resolvió x + 25 = 60 y obtuvo x = 35. Otra detective resolvió y − 25 = 60 y obtuvo y = 35. ¿Están los dos correctos? Explica usando operaciones inversas y comprueba cada respuesta.
hintsEs: Las dos ecuaciones usan operaciones OPUESTAS (+25 y −25), así que el mismo paso inverso no puede servir para ambas.
Resuelve cada una con su propia inversa: resta 25 en x + 25 = 60, pero suma 25 en y − 25 = 60. Luego sustituye cada resultado en su ecuación.
Empieza con x + 25 = 60: resta 25 de ambos lados y compara con el 35 del detective. Luego suma 25 en la ecuación de y y ve si el 35 sobrevive esa prueba.

extending.label: Solve using decimals: x + 2.7 = 9.3. Use inverse operations.
hints: Subtract 2.7 from both sides: x = 9.3 − 2.7.
Subtract 2.7 from 9.3 to find x, then check by adding 2.7 back — you should land on 9.3.
extending.explanation: In x + 2.7 = 9.3 the variable has 2.7 added to it, so subtract 2.7 from both sides: x = 9.3 − 2.7 = 6.6. Line up the decimal points when you subtract, and check by adding back: 6.6 + 2.7 = 9.3.
extending.explanationEs: En x + 2.7 = 9.3 a la variable se le suma 2.7, así que resta 2.7 en ambos lados: x = 9.3 − 2.7 = 6.6. Alinea los puntos decimales al restar y comprueba sumando de regreso: 6.6 + 2.7 = 9.3.

practice.commonMistake: A common mistake is applying the same operation instead of the inverse — for example, solving x − 7 = 15 by subtracting 7 from both sides (getting the wrong x = 8) instead of adding 7 to both sides (the correct x = 22). Another common mistake is doing the inverse operation to only one side, like solving x + 6 = 14 by subtracting 6 from the left but forgetting the right side. Before you submit, name the operation shown in the equation, choose its inverse, apply it to BOTH sides, and check by substituting your answer back into the original equation.

connect.scenario: A hiker has walked some distance and still has 4.5 miles left on a 12-mile trail. The equation d + 4.5 = 12 represents her situation, where d is the distance already walked.
connect.promptQuestion: How far has the hiker walked? How did you use inverse operations?
connect.prompt: The hiker walked ___ miles because d + 4.5 = 12 means d = 12 − ___ = ___.

check.explanation: Subtract 4.5 from both sides: d = 12 − 4.5 = 7.5 miles.
check.explanationEs: Resta 4.5 de los dos lados: d = 12 − 4.5 = 7.5 millas.
choiceFeedback: That's the number already added in, not the value of d that produces 12.
That's close, but check the subtraction again — it isn't quite right.
That adds 4.5 to 12 instead of undoing the addition.
choiceFeedbackEs: Ese es el número que ya se sumó, no el valor de d que produce 12.
Está cerca, pero revisa otra vez la resta — no es del todo correcta.
Eso suma 4.5 a 12 en lugar de deshacer la suma.

check.explanation: Addition and subtraction are inverse operations. Since 4.5 was added to d, subtract 4.5 to isolate d.
check.explanationEs: La suma y la resta son operaciones inversas. Como se le sumó 4.5 a d, resta 4.5 para dejar sola a d.
choiceFeedback: Multiplication is the inverse of division, not of addition.
Division is the inverse of multiplication, not of addition.
Squaring isn't an inverse operation for addition at all.
choiceFeedbackEs: La multiplicación es la inversa de la división, no de la suma.
La división es la inversa de la multiplicación, no de la suma.
Elevar al cuadrado no es una operación inversa de la suma.

choices: Only if the trail is 11 miles
check.explanationEs: 7.5 + 4.5 = 12, que coincide con el largo completo del sendero. ✓
choicesEs: Solo si el sendero mide 11 millas
choiceFeedback: Redo that addition — 7.5 and 4.5 combine to a different total than that.
Substituting means putting the value back into the ORIGINAL operation, not reversing it.
The trail length is fixed at 12 miles, so check whether 7.5 makes that true.
choiceFeedbackEs: Vuelve a hacer esa suma — 7.5 y 4.5 se combinan en un total distinto a ese.
Sustituir significa poner el valor de vuelta en la operación ORIGINAL, no invertirla.
La longitud del sendero es fija en 12 millas, así que revisa si 7.5 lo cumple.

connect.modelAnswer: d + 4.5 = 12. Subtraction undoes addition, so subtract 4.5 from both sides: d = 12 − 4.5 = 7.5 miles walked. Check: 7.5 + 4.5 = 12. ✓
connect.promptEs: La excursionista caminó ___ millas porque d + 4.5 = 12 significa d = 12 − ___ = ___.
connect.scenarioEs: Una excursionista ha caminado cierta distancia y todavía le faltan 4.5 millas de un sendero de 12 millas. La ecuación d + 4.5 = 12 representa su situación, donde d es la distancia que ya caminó.
connect.promptQuestionEs: ¿Qué distancia ha caminado la excursionista? ¿Cómo usaste las operaciones inversas?
connect.modelAnswerEs: d + 4.5 = 12. La resta deshace la suma, así que resta 4.5 de los dos lados: d = 12 − 4.5 = 7.5 millas caminadas. Comprueba: 7.5 + 4.5 = 12. ✓

exitTicket.explanation: Subtract 2.8 from both sides: p = 9.1 − 2.8 = 6.3. Check: 6.3 + 2.8 = 9.1 ✓ (11.9 comes from adding instead of subtracting; 7.7 comes from subtracting each decimal place without regrouping — 9 − 2 = 7 and, without borrowing, 8 − 1 = 7; 3.25 comes from dividing 9.1 ÷ 2.8 instead of subtracting.)
choiceFeedback: Subtract 2.8 from 9.1 — that's not the result.
Recheck your subtraction: 9.1 − 2.8 in the tenths place.
You added 2.8 — undo it by subtracting from both sides.
hints: p has 2.8 added to it. To get p alone you must undo the addition — decimals follow the same rule as whole numbers.
Subtract 2.8 from both sides. Line up the decimal points and watch the tenths place for regrouping.
Set up 9.1 − 2.8: you can't take 8 tenths from 1 tenth, so borrow from the 9 first. Then check by adding 2.8 back to your result.
exitTicket.explanationEs: Resta 2.8 de los dos lados: p = 9.1 − 2.8 = 6.3. Comprueba: 6.3 + 2.8 = 9.1 ✓ (11.9 sale de sumar en vez de restar; 7.7 sale de restar cada lugar decimal sin reagrupar — 9 − 2 = 7 y, sin pedir prestado, 8 − 1 = 7; 3.25 sale de dividir 9.1 ÷ 2.8 en vez de restar.)
choiceFeedbackEs: Réstale 2.8 a 9.1 — ese no es el resultado.
Revisa tu resta: 9.1 − 2.8 en el lugar de las décimas.
Sumaste 2.8 — deshazlo restando de los dos lados.
hintsEs: A p se le suma 2.8. Para dejar p sola tienes que deshacer la suma — los decimales siguen la misma regla que los números enteros.
Resta 2.8 de los dos lados. Alinea los puntos decimales y fíjate en el lugar de las décimas para reagrupar.
Arma 9.1 − 2.8: no le puedes quitar 8 décimas a 1 décima, así que primero pídele prestado al 9. Luego comprueba sumándole 2.8 a tu resultado.

partA.stem: Which value of n is the solution of n − 18 = 27?
partA.explanation: The variable has 18 subtracted from it, so add 18 to both sides to isolate n: n = 27 + 18 = 45. Check by substituting: 45 − 18 = 27.
choiceFeedback: That subtracts 18 from 27. The variable already had 18 taken away, so ADD it back.
That is the value after 18 was subtracted, not n itself. Add 18 to recover n.
That is the amount subtracted, not the solution. Add it to 27.

partB.stem: Which reasoning justifies the step used to find that answer?
choices: Because 18 is subtracted from n, adding 18 to both sides is the inverse operation that leaves n by itself.
Because the equation shows subtraction, 18 should be subtracted from both sides as well.
Because the number written after the equal sign is always the value of the variable.
Because the smaller number in a subtraction equation is always the solution.
partB.explanation: Subtraction is undone by addition. Adding 18 to both sides keeps the equation balanced and isolates the variable, giving n = 45. Subtracting 18 from both sides instead would give 27 − 18 = 9, and 9 − 18 does not equal 27.

mstarPractice.title: Type II Reasoning: Adding When the Inverse Is Subtraction
mstarPractice.scenario: Darius solved the equation x + 23 = 40. He wrote: 'x + 23 = 40, so x = 40 + 23, which means x = 63.'
mstarPractice.prompt: Explain Darius's misconception and give the correct value of x.

rubric.score2: Student explains that adding 23 is undone by subtracting 23 from both sides, not by adding again, and gives x = 17.
rubric.score1: Student gives x = 17 but does not explain why subtraction is the inverse operation needed.
rubric.score0: Student agrees with Darius or gives an unrelated response.

mstarPractice.correctAnswer: x = 17. The 23 is being added to x, so the inverse operation is subtraction: subtract 23 from both sides to get x = 40 − 23 = 17. Check by substituting: 17 + 23 = 40. Darius's answer fails the same check, because 63 + 23 = 86, not 40.

choiceFeedback: 'Plus' means addition, but the phrase says 'times,' which means multiplication.

'Menos que' significa restar, no dividir — la frase nunca dice 'dividido entre.'
